name: acml-website
description: Builds the site's Tailwind CSS files (css/tailwind.css and css/tailwind-default.css) and the full-text search index of the paper pages (pagefind/).

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i css/tailwind.src.css -o css/tailwind.css --minify && cross-env TAILWIND_THEME=default tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i css/tailwind.src.css -o css/tailwind-default.css --minify
